Effective September 14, 2026. These Terms form an agreement between you and Troy Reardon for your use of Flap Fit. Contact: awesome-eh@hotmail.com.

Eligibility and acceptance

You must be at least 13 and legally able to accept these Terms. A parent or guardian must approve use where local law requires it. By using Flap Fit, and separately by accepting the Competition Terms before using Compete, you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy.

Fitness safety

Flap Fit is a fitness game, not medical advice or a medical device. Camera tracking, scores, and training-time totals are estimates. Use a clear, non-slip area, secure the phone, use equipment only as intended, and choose movements appropriate for your ability. Stop exercising and seek appropriate help if you feel pain, dizziness, faintness, unusual shortness of breath, or another concerning symptom. Consult a qualified health professional before starting a new exercise program if you have an injury, medical condition, or other concern. Never prioritize a game score over safe form.

We grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use Flap Fit for lawful, non-commercial purposes on supported devices. You may not copy, sell, reverse engineer, interfere with, or exploit the app or service except where applicable law expressly permits it.

Online competition and public content

Compete is optional. Player names, leaderboard scores, challenges, and challenge results may be visible to other players. Do not submit obscene content, hate or discrimination, threats, harassment, bullying, impersonation, fraud, spam, illegal content, or content that violates another person's rights. Do not cheat, manipulate scores, obtain unauthorized access, evade limits, or disrupt the service.

You can report or block another player beside that player's public leaderboard result, challenge, or challenge attempt. We may filter, restrict, hide, or remove content; suspend online access; preserve minimum necessary evidence; and contact appropriate authorities when reasonably necessary to enforce these rules or protect users.

Your account and deletion

Compete uses an anonymous online account without requiring an email, phone number, or password. Access may be lost if you delete the app, clear its data, or lose the device. In-app deletion is available at Info > Delete online profile. A deletion path that does not require the app is available on the Delete online data page.

Record & Play and sharing

Record & Play makes a temporary, silent video on your device. You control whether and where it is shared. Do not record or share another person without permission, and do not share content that is illegal or violates another person's privacy, publicity, or intellectual-property rights. We may update, suspend, or discontinue features, including online competition. Local progress may be lost when the app or its data is deleted. We do not promise uninterrupted or error-free operation. To the extent permitted by law, Flap Fit is provided "as is" and "as available." Nothing in these Terms excludes rights or remedies that cannot legally be excluded.
